en.file.invalid_base64: Invalid file content. Choose the file again.
en.file.too_large: Each file can be at most 5 MiB. Split the export into batches.
en.config.object: Field settings must be an object.
en.encoding.unsupported: Unsupported encoding. Choose UTF-8 or Windows-1252.
en.encoding.decode: The file does not use the selected encoding. Convert it to UTF-8 or select Windows-1252.
en.csv.null_byte: The file contains null bytes and may not be CSV. Export it again from the original application.
en.csv.delimiter: Only comma, semicolon and tab delimiters are supported.
en.csv.headers: Column headers are duplicated or exceed 100 columns. Correct them first.
en.csv.columns: CSV physical line {line} has a different number of columns from the header. Check quoting and delimiters.
en.csv.empty: The CSV is empty. Choose a file with a header row.
en.money.double_sign: A parenthesized negative amount cannot also have a sign
en.money.format: Invalid amount format (no currency symbols, scientific notation or irregular grouping; at most 8 decimal places)
en.config.invert: The invert setting must be a boolean true or false, not a string.
en.mapping.missing: Map the date, payee and amount columns. Split amounts require both debit and credit columns.
en.mapping.duplicate: Required fields cannot map to the same column.
en.account.default: Enter an explicit default account when no account column is mapped.
en.currency.default: Enter a three-letter default currency, such as USD, EUR or CNY, when no currency column is mapped.
en.date.pattern: Date does not match the selected format; include the full year and two-digit month and day
en.date.invalid: Date does not exist or has the wrong format
en.money.split: Debit and credit must be nonnegative and cannot both be nonzero
en.currency.invalid: Currency must be three letters; complete the currency value
en.payee.empty: Payee is empty; add a description in the source CSV and check again
en.options.day_window: Date tolerance must be an integer from 0 to 7.
en.error.existing_invalid: Invalid rows in the existing ledger: {count}. Overlap cannot be checked reliably. Fix these first: {details}
en.reason.batch_id_conflict: The incoming file repeats a transaction ID within the same account/currency. Keep each entry and check the original export.
en.reason.trusted_id_duplicate: The same ID system was confirmed; the unique ID, date, amount, account and currency match.
en.reason.id_conflict: The same ID matches several existing records, or its date/amount differs from history.
en.reason.candidates_same_day: The same account/currency has same-day, same-amount entries. These may overlap or be separate real purchases.{id_warning}
en.reason.candidates_date_window: The same account/currency has same-amount entries within {window} days.{id_warning}
en.reason.id_differs: IDs differ; do not exclude based on amount alone.
en.reason.batch_repeat: The incoming file has multiple entries with the same date, amount and payee. Keep each and confirm whether they are real purchases.
en.reason.no_candidates: No candidates were found within the supplied history. Check the export coverage.
en.decisions.unknown_line: Review decisions reference nonexistent line numbers. Run the check again.
en.decisions.invalid: Review decisions must be include, exclude or pending.
en.decisions.invalid_include: Line {line} is invalid and cannot be included. Fix the source file and run the check again.
en.export.target_warning: Preview each file in its matching account and currency. The target still applies its own rules/deduplication; this bundle does not prove a successful target-ledger import.
en.export.unresolved_warning: Pending and invalid rows are excluded from ready_rows.csv. Check review.csv row by row.
en.export.scope_warning: Only the supplied history was compared. This does not prove complete absence of overlap or direct compatibility with the target application.
en.http.loopback: Only local loopback addresses are accepted.
en.http.origin: Requests from other websites are rejected. Open the local page directly.
en.http.size: The request is empty or too large; each CSV can be at most 5 MiB.
en.http.object: The request must be a JSON object.
en.http.invalid: Invalid input. Check the CSV and field settings.
en.http.timeout: The read timed out. Choose the file again.
en.cli.exported: Exported {path}. Check README, review.csv and audit.json in the ZIP first.
en.cli.server_start_failed: Cannot start: {detail}. If the port is in use, choose another with --port.
en.cli.server_ready: Processing stays in local memory. Press Ctrl+C to stop.
en.export.readme:
ImportGuard {version}
Selected: {include}; excluded: {exclude}; pending: {pending}.
{layout}ready_rows.csv preserves input column order (UTF-8 BOM, comma separated). Dangerous text cells receive a leading apostrophe to prevent formula execution.
normalized_rows.csv uses ISO dates and signed amounts with a decimal point; negative amounts are outflows. Preview column mapping and amount direction in the target application.
review.csv keeps rows not included; audit.json keeps all rows, reasons, input hashes and decisions.
Keep the original CSV and ledger backups. Preview a small batch in the target application; this tool never writes back to your ledger.
Only supplied history is checked; unexported entries, missing descriptions, split transactions and currency conversions can hide overlap.
en.export.layout_multiple:
This bundle contains {count} account/currency groups. Use import-manifest.json to select the matching files under accounts/ and import each into its matching account/currency.
Root all_*_REVIEW_ONLY.csv files are for combined review only; do not import them into one account. Multi-account bundles do not include a mixed ready_rows.csv.
en.export.layout_single: Single-account bundles keep ready_rows.csv and normalized_rows.csv at the root. These are two formats of the same entries; import one, not both.
en.csv.too_many_rows: Each CSV can contain at most 20,000 rows. Split it into batches.

zh-CN.export.readme:
ImportGuard {version}
已选新增：{include}；排除：{exclude}；待定：{pending}。
{layout}ready_rows.csv保留输入字段顺序（UTF-8 BOM，逗号分隔），危险文本单元格加单引号防公式执行。
normalized_rows.csv为ISO日期、有符号点小数金额，负数支出；请在目标应用预览确认映射与金额方向。
review.csv保留未加入行，audit.json保留全部行、依据、输入哈希及决策。
保留原CSV及账本备份，在目标应用小批预览；本工具不回写账本。
只检查用户提供的历史范围，不能发现未导出/描述缺失/拆分或跨币种转换的重叠。
zh-CN.export.layout_multiple:
本包有{count}个账户/币种组合：请按import-manifest.json选择accounts/下对应文件，逐个导入相同账户和币种。
根目录all_*_REVIEW_ONLY.csv只供汇总复核，不要导入单个账户。多账户包不再提供混合ready_rows.csv。
zh-CN.export.layout_single: 单账户包保留根目录ready_rows.csv与normalized_rows.csv；它们是两种格式，选择一种导入，勿重复。
